description: Source file implementing the GLExtensions class, which manages OpenGL and EGL extension information, including initialization and querying extension support.

classes.name: ExtensionSet
classes.description: Helper class to parse and check for the presence of OpenGL/EGL extensions from extension strings.

methods.name: initWithGLStrings
methods.description: Initializes the GLExtensions object with vendor, renderer, version, and extension strings from OpenGL.

methods.name: initWithEGLStrings
methods.description: Initializes the GLExtensions object with EGL version and extension strings, and sets support flags for various EGL extensions.

methods.name: getVendor
methods.description: Returns the vendor string of the GPU.
